missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Метр' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Один' agrees as the masculine numeral, and 'ста сантиметрам' is the dative complement.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Метр' is the accusative object of 'нужен' frame; this inanimate masculine noun looks like the nominative. 'Ткани' is the genitive material.
Strategic focus: Genitive after comparison. 'Метра' is the genitive form after 'меньше', expressing how little distance remains. 'До дома' marks the endpoint.

missions.phrase: Этому метру ткани я очень рад.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Метру' is the dative form after 'рад', the thing the speaker is glad of. 'Этому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Accusative of measure. 'Метр' is the accusative form after 'на', expressing the amount of difference. 'Стена' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О метре' uses the prepositional form 'метре' after 'о' to express the topic. 'Квадратном' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive after a numeral. 'Метра' is the genitive singular form required after 'два'. 'Верёвки' is the genitive material being measured.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Метров' is the genitive plural after 'пять', counting the length. 'В рулоне' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Метры' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят'. 'Эти' agrees as the plural demonstrative, and 'дорого' gives the price judgement.

missions.phrase: Этот стол длиной почти два метра.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of measure. 'Метра' is the genitive singular after 'два' within the measure phrase. 'Длиной' is the instrumental specifying dimension.
